title: Paladin — complete skill frame set
source: maplestory.io, GMS version 270 (skillbook API for jobs 100/120/121/122/124/40001; WZ API for paths/metadata)

skills.name: Iron Body
skills.description: Boosts DEF and Max HP by a set percentage, and decreases damage taken when hit by enemies.

skills.name: Guardian Armor
skills.description: Increase Battle Mode ATT based on DEF.

skills.name: Warrior Mastery
skills.description: Trains up your warrior basics to increase Movement Speed, Jump, Max HP, and Max Movement Speed. Also grants a chance to resist knockback.

skills.name: Slash Blast
skills.description: Consumes MP to attack nearby enemies all at once.

skills.name: War Leap
skills.description: Leap once more while already in the air. Press the up key at the same time to move upward.

skills.name: Leap Attack
skills.description: Ambush the enemy by rapidly dropping to ground from mid-air.\nCan only be used if there's a platform within range below you. Use along with a left or right arrow keys to drop yourself diagonally.\nCan also be used by pressing the downward, left, or right arrow keys plus the attack key, instead of manually activating the skill.

skills.name: War Leap
skills.description: Charge through the air to attack the enemy. Can also be used by pressing the upward arrow key plus the attack key.\nRight-click to lock command.

skills.name: Weapon Mastery
skills.description: Increases Sword Mastery, Blunt Weapon Mastery, and Attack Speed.

skills.name: Final Attack
skills.description: Chance to activate an additional hit after a direct attack skill. Must have a sword or a blunt weapon equipped.

skills.name: Agile Arms
skills.description: Increases Attack Speed and Strength.

skills.name: Physical Training
skills.description: Permanently increases STR and DEX through sheer physical training.

skills.name: Vessel of Light
skills.description: Amass the power of light within yourself through the use of Holy Power skills.

skills.name: Knockback Resistance
skills.description: Concentrates to hold your ground when struck, resisting knockback effects permanently.

skills.name: Close Combat
skills.description: Pulls in enemies to either side of you, while dealing damage and slowing them down. Can be resisted by some enemies.

skills.name: Divine Swing
skills.description: [Holy Power]\nSwing a large hammer conjured from light, damaging and stunning nearby enemies.

skills.name: Shield Mastery
skills.description: Increases Elemental Resistance, Abnormal Status Resistance, Defense, and Attack Power when a shield or rosary is equipped. Gives your shield a chance to block and stun enemies.

skills.name: Parashock Guard
skills.description: Reduces damage that nearby party members receive when they are hit. Grants your party members a chance to guard themselves. Increases your Attack Power.

skills.name: Achilles
skills.description: Permanently increases your defensive abilities so you take less damage from enemies.

skills.name: Divine Shield
skills.description: When struck, generate a shield with a chance to block up to 10 blows. The shield also increases Attack Power. The shield lasts for 90 seconds, and must cool down before reactivation. The Attack Power increase remains, even after blocking all blows.\nRight-click to lock activation effect.

skills.name: HP Recovery
skills.description: Instantly recovers your HP. Higher skill levels will restore more health. Restores less HP when used repeatedly.

skills.name: Combat Orders
skills.description: Temporarily grants bonus skill levels to the skills of all party members, including yourself. 4th job skills that have already reached the master level can be raised further. Other skills can only be increased to master level.\nExceptions: Some special skills, beginner skills, Combat Orders, hyper skills, 5th job skills, and 6th job skills cannot be increased.

skills.name: Rush
skills.description: Dashes forward and pushes back multiple monsters. Can be resisted by some monsters.

skills.name: Noble Demand
skills.description: Releases the pride of the Holy Knight, granting a chance to temporarily decrease the Attack Power, Defense, and Accuracy of multiple enemies nearby.

skills.name: Divine Charge
skills.description: [Holy Power]\nInstantly conjures a holy hammer that slams your enemies, silencing them and inflicting damage.

skills.name: Greater Vessel of Light
skills.description: Empowers Vessel of Light to its limit with your mastery. Increases Divine Charge's max number of targets and the attack count of both Divine Charge and Blast. Overrides the effect of Vessel of Light.

skills.name: High Paladin
skills.description: Increases Weapon Mastery, Defense, Critical Rate, Critical Damage, Ignore Defense, and Final Damage through your extensive experience as a Paladin. Critical Damage, Ignore Defense, or Mastery will also be enhanced depending on the type of weapon you have equipped.

skills.name: Divine Judgment
skills.description: Marks enemies struck by your Blast skill with a Divine Brand. Upon reaching the max number of stacks, the Divine Brands detonate, inflicting additional damage that ignores some of the enemy's Defense. Blasts from party members under the effect of Divine Echo do not grant additional Divine Brand stacks.

skills.name: Blast - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the damage of Blast.

skills.name: Blast - Critical Chance
skills.description: Increases Critical Rate of Blast.

skills.name: Blast - Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases Blasts's number of attacks.

skills.name: Heaven's Hammer - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases damage of Heaven's Hammer.

skills.name: Heaven's Hammer - Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases Heaven's Hammer number of attacks.

skills.name: Heaven's Hammer - Cooldown Cutter
skills.description: Reduces the cooldown of Heaven's Hammer.

skills.name: Divine Charge - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the damage of Divine Charge.

skills.name: Divine Charge - Critical Chance
skills.description: Increases the Critical Rate of Divine Charge.

skills.name: Divine Charge - Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases the attack count of Divine Charge.

skills.name: Maple Warrior
skills.description: The Goddess of Maple World's grace increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Goddess of Maple World appear.

skills.name: Blast
skills.description: [Holy Power]\nCall upon the full divine might of the Paladin to deal a powerful blow to your enemies.

skills.name: Heaven's Hammer
skills.description: Slam a large hammer into the ground, dealing damage to multiple enemies.\nYou deal additional damage to bosses and are not affected by pushback while casting Heaven's Hammer.

skills.name: Hero's Will
skills.description: Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.\nCan be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Magic Crash
skills.description: Chance to remove certain buffs from affected enemies and prevent them regaining those buffs.\nEnemies hit will resist Magic Crash for 90 seconds. Buffs Removed: Attack Power & Magic ATT Bonuses, DEF Bonuses, and Obsidian Skin.

skills.name: Divine Blessing
skills.description: Receive a holy blessing and temporarily increase Final Damage.

skills.name: Guardian
skills.description: Revive one party member, closest to you, and make both the revived party member and yourself invulnerable for short time. The post-revival invincibility's duration cannot be increased by buffs.

skills.name: Divine Mark
skills.description: [Holy Power]\nAllows you to summon a more powerful holy hammer. Enhances the damage and range of Divine Charge. Divine Mark can be used at regular intervals. When Divine Mark is used, a brand of light appears at the target location, detonating after a set period and striking enemies in a wide area. This explosion deals additional damage to normal enemies. Divine Mark explosions aren't triggered by party members affected by Divine Echo.

skills.name: Smite Shield
skills.description: Summons a hammer imbued with unyielding strength to strike down nearby enemies. Enemies struck have some of their buffs removed, and are unable to regain those buffs for the duration of the stun.\nBuffs Removed: Attack Power & Magic ATT Bonuses, DEF Bonuses, and Obsidian Skin.\nEnemies hit will resist stuns from Smite Shield and other skills for 90 seconds.

skills.name: Epic Adventure
skills.description: Call upon the bravery deep within to increase damage output.

skills.name: Sacrosanctity
skills.description: Call upon the heavens to protect you from all attacks for a short time. Reusing this skill will end its effect immediately, while also shortening its cooldown in proportion to the skill's remaining duration.

skills.name: Sacrosanctity
skills.description: Call upon the heavens to protect you from all attacks for a short time.

skills.name: Divine Echo
skills.description: Grants an echo of your battle prowess to a nearby party member, such that they will mirror some of your attack skills and buff skills. If the last party member who received the echo is within range, that party member will receive the echo first. If a party member approaches you while your echo is inactive, that party member receives your echo. When the party member moves beyond a certain distance from you, or when Divine Echo is deactivated, the echo is lost. At that time, any Paladin's buffs applied to that party member will also be removed. This skill cannot be used on a party member who is already echoing the skills of another Paladin. If you use the skill again while skill is active, you can select which party member will receive your echo by pressing the corresponding number key (with regard to the party UI). You cannot select yourself, a party member who is already echoing someone, or a party member who cannot receive an echo.\nA party member who is echoing can't receive a full Divine Blessing.

skills.name: Divine Echo
skills.description: Grants an echo of your battle prowess to a party member. It cannot be used on a party member who is already echoing the skills of another Paladin.
skills.note: Invisible variant entry in the skillbook; no effect/hit frames (the visible cast is the sibling entry with the same name).

skills.name: Hammers of the Righteous
skills.description: Summons a whirling bulwark of righteous hammers to strike down nearby enemies. Use the skill again to stop the attack. Unaffected by attack reflection.
skills.note: ball layer (15 frames) holds the whirling-hammer visuals; extracted as ball-XX.webp.

skills.name: Hammers of the Righteous
skills.description: Summons a whirling bulwark of righteous hammers to strike down nearby enemies.
skills.note: ball layer (22 frames) holds the whirling-hammer visuals; extracted as ball-XX.webp.

skills.name: Grand Guardian
skills.description: A glorious cross-section of light blazes, symbolizing noble sacrifice. You can continuously attack while moving, and can gain more strength the longer the sacrifice continues. You are immune to knockback and debilitating abnormal statuses while casting the skill.

skills.name: Mighty Mjolnir
skills.description:
Summon the hammer of an ancient god, then hurl it straight toward your enemies.
Using the directional keys, you can throw up to 4 copies of the hammer at once. Each successful hit creates a powerful shockwave.
Use the Attack key to summon and throw all hammers at once.
While Omnia Mode is active, use the skill key without the attack key to summon and throw every available hammer.
The hammers track down the enemy with the highest HP, aside from the one it had just attacked. All of the hammers' attacks are unaffected by attack reflection.
Omnia Mode On/Off: Right-click

skills.name: HEXA Divine Judgment
skills.description: Marks enemies struck by your Blast skill with a Divine Brand. Upon reaching the max number of stacks, the Divine Brands detonate, inflicting additional damage that ignores some of the enemy's Defense. Blasts from party members under the effect of Divine Echo do not grant additional Divine Brand stacks.

skills.name: HEXA Final Attack
skills.description: Grants a chance to deal a powerful additional hit after landing a direct skill attack.\nMust have a sword or a blunt weapon equipped.

skills.name: HEXA Blast
skills.description: [Holy Power]\nCalls upon the full divine might of the Paladin to deal a powerful blow to your enemies.

skills.name: HEXA Divine Charge
skills.description: [Holy Power]\nInstantly conjures a holy hammer that slams your enemies, silencing them and inflicting damage. HEXA Divine Mark periodically upgrades the holy hammer with consecrated light.

skills.name: HEXA Divine Mark
skills.description: [Holy Power]\nDetonates the stigmata of light using a holy hammer, inflicting damage upon the enemies and silencing them.

skills.name: Falling Justice
skills.description: Enact divine justice with the Holy Knight's power.\nFalling Justice's cooldown can be reduced. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: HEXA Heaven's Hammer
skills.description: Slams a large hammer into the ground, dealing damage to multiple enemies.\nYou deal additional damage to bosses and are not affected by pushback while casting HEXA Heaven's Hammer. Marks hit enemies with the Divine Brand from Divine Judgment. In addition, permanently increases the damage of HEXA Blast and HEXA Divine Judgment.

skills.name: Rising Justice
skills.description: Intensifies the shock from Falling Justice so that shards of justice rise up from the impact.\nThe shards of justice chase down and attack enemies. Unaffected by attack reflection. Targets the boss with the highest HP first.

skills.name: Sacred Bastion
skills.description:
The Holy Knight shimmers brilliantly, casting judgment upon enemies and relief upon allies.

Lv. 10: Ignore Defense +20%
Lv. 20: Boss Damage +20%
Lv. 30: Ignore Defense +30% and Boss Damage +30%

skills.name: Sacred Bastion
skills.description: The Holy Knight shimmers brilliantly, casting judgment upon enemies and relief upon allies.

skills.name: Dominus Oblivion
skills.description:
Grants the blessing of holy light, armoring you in light and striking out with a blow of implacable justice.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 20 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +20%

skills.name: Divine Echo Boost / Hammers of the Righteous Boost / Grand Guardian Boost / Mighty Mjolnir Boost
skills.description: HEXA enhancement cores for the four 5th-job skills (passive, Level Requirement 260).
skills.note: All 669 IDs in the Skill/40000.img 400004xxx block were scanned by name (4000040xx block plus 400004100-400004885); every entry is a 1st-4th-job Boost core and none is a V-skill Boost. The 400001xxx block holds common skills (Rope Lift, Decent skills, Blitz Shield) and 400007xxx holds HEXA stat cores, so no "<V skill> Boost" entry exists in Skill/40000.img in GMS 270. They are passive cores with no effect/hit frames, so no visuals are missing.

The 400001xxx block holds common skills and 400007xxx holds HEXA stat cores, so no "<V skill> Boost" entry exists in Skill/40000.img in GMS 270. Passive cores with no frames, so no visuals missing.

notes: Jobs ending in 4 (114/124/134) are the 6th-job (HEXA) skillbooks, not Hyper books: job 124 holds Paladin's HEXA skills (HEXA Blast, HEXA Divine Judgment, HEXA Divine Charge, HEXA Divine Mark, HEXA Heaven's Hammer, HEXA Final Attack) plus the Origin skills Falling Justice, Sacred Bastion and Dominus Oblivion, each with its own effect/hit frames in GMS 270.
Unlike Hero (whose HEXA Raging Blow shares Raging Blow 1121008's frames), Paladin's HEXA skills have distinct effect/hit nodes in Skill/124.img — no shared-frame entries are used.
Hammers of the Righteous visuals live in the skill's 'ball' layer (15 + 22 frames), extracted as ball-XX.webp.
Divine Echo 400011021 is an invisible variant entry with no effect/hit frames; the visible cast is 400011003.

HEXA boost cores for the class's 1st–4th-job skills are recorded as passive entries (400004011 Final Attack, 400004014 Divine Judgment, 400004015 Divine Mark, 400004018 Divine Charge, 400004019 Blast, 400004020 Heaven's Hammer).
Size: Paladin frames are large full-screen effects (up to about 1120x764); the class totals about 60 MB WebP at q80, well above Hero's about 13 MB — reported, not trimmed.
